conflicts.permit: To operate the Services, we may share your personal information with our agents, representatives, contractors and service providers so they can provide us with support services such as authorization of credit card transactions, email origination, receipt or support services, and customer relationship management services.
conflicts.prohibit: We require these entities not to use your information for any other purpose.
conflicts.situation: When personal data is shared with service providers/third parties.
conflicts.reason: The policy immediately contradicts itself by stating that third parties are authorized to use the information in accordance with their own privacy policies over which WooPlus has no control.
